data.cultural_impact: The name Nooh is of great cultural significance in Islamic traditions. Prophet Nooh (Noh in Arabic) is considered the first prophet to carry the message of monotheism to humanity after the flood. He is revered for his unwavering patience and strong faith in Allah, even during the longest and most arduous trial when he was ordered to build an ark to save his family and the cattle from the coming great flood. The story of Prophet Nooh is a reminder of Allah's mercy and compassion towards his believers, and his promise to save and protect them.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Nooh lies in its symbolism of peace, calmness, and tranquility. It is a namesake of a prophet who was selected by Allah to carry the message of monotheism, despite the long and arduous trial of building an ark to save his family and the cattle from the flood. The name Nooh represents the inner peace and calmness that can be achieved through unwavering faith and patience in Allah, even during the most challenging times. It serves as a reminder of the power and promise of Allah to save and protect his believers, and to provide them with peace and calmness in their faith.
